theme: hybrid (light base with massive dark structural blocks)

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large manifesto numbers, editorial quotes. Never use bold for headings, stick to 300/400 for elegance.

secondary_ui.usage: Body copy, product names, navigation, buttons, overlines.
secondary_ui.tracking_rules: Overlines must be tracking-[0.2em] uppercase. Body text tracking-normal.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere to create architectural grid structures. Avoid soft rounded borders (max rounded-sm). Use sharp edges for a premium editorial look.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle SVG noise grain overlay fixed at z-0 with opacity 2% to kill digital flatness.

layouts.grid_system: Asymmetrical Bento and Swiss Grids. md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 or gap-12.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding. Use py-24 or py-32 for section vertical rhythm. Containers should have ample breathing room.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and product info. Center-align only brief manifesto statements or marquee content.
layouts.hero_structure: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-end pb-24 px-8 md:px-16. Massive typographic emphasis.

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Wrap each text line in a hidden overflow container, and translate Y from 100% to 0% with ease-[0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] duration 1s.
motion.scroll_animations: Fade and slight translateY (20px) on scroll using framer-motion's whileInView. Stagger children for product grids.
motion.micro_interactions: Image scales slightly (scale-105) on hover inside an overflow-hidden wrapper. Buttons slide an arrow icon horizontally on hover.
motion.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll to slightly translate the hero image Y axis for depth.

components.navigation: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism header (z-50). Logo left, links center, Cart/Quote button right.

product_card.style: Cardless, sharp edges. Image container with aspect-[4/5] overflow-hidden bg-zinc-100. Product name and category directly below image.
product_card.image_treatment: Images must feel like a spotlight. Mix clipped frames and ample negative space.

components.buttons: Sharp-edged (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Hover state inverts colors or adds a 1px border. Use group-hover for internal icon motion.

marquee.style: The 'Editorial Ribbon'. Low contrast (warm sand background, emerald text), slow smooth drift, uppercase serif or mono text separated by star/diamond icons.

components.manifesto_chapters: Large numbers (01, 02) in Cormorant Garamond, paired with a small paragraph of brand philosophy. Border-top on each chapter to create a ledger/document look.
components.forms: Guest Enquiry Form: Shadcn UI elements but heavily customized. Square corners, thin borders, floating labels or minimal top labels. Background must match the container.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary dark text over warm sand backgrounds meets WCAG AA (4.5:1).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion props with prefers-reduced-motion checks if necessary.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, cart add, form inputs, navigation links) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case based on role (e.g. data-testid="cart-checkout-button").

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY JavaScript (.js / .jsx). DO NOT output TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure Shadcn UI components are installed and modified to remove 'Vercel' rounded corners, replacing them with sharp, premium edges.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Install 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts in index.css.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on interactive overlays like dropdowns or sticky navs. Always use solid or heavily blurred glass.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root level.

Implement the Enquiry Cart state using a global store (Zustand or React Context) so users can add products from the grid and review them in a slide-out cart or separate page before submitting the quote form.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text, which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toast notifications, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions only to specific properties like opacity, background-color, or transform.
